# RemaJu Explorer

Independent static explorer of Peruvian judicial auctions. The demo contains an incomplete sample extracted on 2026-11-07; it is not a current or complete availability dataset.

- [Data access guide](data-access.md)
- [Demo manifest](demo/manifest.json)
- [Downloads](downloads)

The source is REMAJU. Data is a snapshot and must not be interpreted as legal advice or proof that an absent auction was sold.
